'''KU-Key''' is a KU-Roro who was assigned to Rover to help clear the corrupted data at the Black Shores and gave access portals [[Shorekeeper|Shorekeepers]] portals across the island. 

==Quests and Events==
{{Quests and Events|KU-Key}}

==Idle==
:;What a lovely day!
:;Woo-hoo! Master, is there any other place you want to go?

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Besides the Energy Hub Resonance Beacon)
:'''KU-Key:''' Master, there seems to be a powerful enemy on the other side of this mysterious portal. Would you like to check it out?
:{{DIcon}} How powerful?
:{{DIcon}} Can't wait.!

;(Outside the Modulation Hall)
:'''KU-Key:''' Hiya, Master {{Rover}}!
:'''KU-Key:''' Good news! The Sonoros lingering in the Black Shores can now be used as portals to access the island!
:{{DIcon}} Amazing.
:{{DIcon|Exit}} Maybe next time.
{{Dialogue End}}
